title: Degree and a junta witness core
statement: Let $r\ge 0$, let $g:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,r\}$. Suppose $g$ depends only on coordinates in $J$. Fix every coordinate outside $J$ to $+1$ and regard the resulting function as a function on the coordinates in $J$. The algebraic degree over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the encoding of $g$ is at most that of the encoding of this restricted function.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $r$ coordinates
